nodes.summary: Serve the ordered reading-list view.
nodes.instructions: Implement the read workflow for the primary reading-list page. Retrieve books through the persistence contract in insertion order, render the collection or a clear empty-list state, and expose the primary GET / route.
nodes.name: Serve the ordered reading-list view.

nodes.summary: Add a valid book to the reading list.
nodes.instructions: Implement the valid book submission workflow at POST /books. Accept title and author form values, create the book through the persistence contract, and redirect or render the updated list so the newly stored book is visible.
nodes.name: Add a valid book to the reading list.

nodes.summary: Remove a selected book from the reading list.
nodes.instructions: Implement removal at POST /books/<book_id>/delete. Delete only the selected persisted book through the repository contract and ensure the next reading-list request omits it.
nodes.name: Remove a selected book from the reading list.

nodes.summary: Reject incomplete book submissions with correction feedback.
nodes.instructions: Add boundary validation for POST /books. Reject an empty title, an empty author, or both before persistence, report which required field is missing, and preserve a usable form workflow so the reader can correct and resubmit.
nodes.name: Reject incomplete book submissions with correction feedback.
